title: How a knit hat caused the death of Fiona the hippo
excerpt: Veterinary experts explain the medical reasons behind the tragic death of Fiona, the famous 9-year-old Cincinnati Zoo hippo, after swallowing a hat.
body_html:
Fiona, the well-known nine-year-old hippopotamus at the Cincinnati Zoo, has died after consuming a knit hat. The animal, who previously gained fame for surviving a premature birth, weighed roughly 2,500 pounds, raising questions about how a foreign object of that size could prove fatal to such a massive creature.

Following the incident, veterinary experts have provided insight into the medical mechanisms behind the tragedy. Even for a large animal like a hippopotamus, foreign items such as clothing can cause severe internal blockages and digestive complications that are difficult to overcome.
